name: @ruokee/omp-qol
description: OMP extension adjusting hub waiting, model-error recovery, and the experimental remote compaction deadline

enabled.description: Master switch. When false, no module changes OMP behavior.

waitEnabled.description: Wrap the hub tool so one call keeps waiting across empty native windows.

waitContinueEmptyWindows.description: Continue inside one hub wait call when the native window came back empty.

waitJobsSeconds.description: Default total wait deadline in seconds for job or mixed hub waits.

waitMessagesSeconds.description: Default total wait deadline in seconds for a pure message hub wait.

waitProcessSeconds.description: Default timeout in seconds for a named-process hub wait.

recoveryEnabled.description: Request a bounded continuation turn after eligible model errors.

recoveryMode.description: Error scope eligible for recovery: classified transient and timeout errors, or also unclassified errors.

recoveryMaxAttempts.description: Consecutive continuations requested for one failure chain.

recoveryBackoffBaseMs.description: Delay before the first continuation in milliseconds.

recoveryBackoffMaxMs.description: Upper bound for the continuation delay in milliseconds.

recoveryNotify.description: Show a warning line for each requested continuation.

compactionTimeoutEnabled.description: Install the experimental process-wide AbortSignal.timeout adjustment. Off by default.

compactionTimeoutMs.description: Deadline in milliseconds applied to one matching timeout call.

compactionTimeoutFloorMs.description: Lowest timeout value the experiment raises. Expert setting; only a numeric filter.

compactionWindowGuardMs.description: Longest lifetime in milliseconds of one compaction window.

compactionTimeoutNotify.description: Show a warning line when the experiment rewrites a deadline.
